checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does verify_data_column_sidecar reject sidecars with empty kzg_commitments?

reachability.notes: Attacker can craft sidecar with empty commitments and send via gossip.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Locate the verify_data_column_sidecar function in the gossip validation pipeline. 2. Identify where kzg_commitments length is checked. 3. Craft a malicious DataColumnSidecar with kzg_commitments = [] (empty array). 4. Submit the crafted sidecar via P2P gossip network. 5. Verify the sidecar is REJECTED at the validation layer before any downstream processing. 6. Check for potential division-by-zero or panic conditions if validation is bypassed. 7. Review all code paths that consume kzg_commitments to ensure they handle empty arrays safely even if validation fails.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0014, Trust Boundary: tb-001, Source Invariant: p2p-SG-002-INV-002. Empty commitments sidecar could cause division-by-zero or unexpected behavior in downstream processing.

checklist.title: Verify Gossip Network Actor Handles Empty Commitment Sidecars Safely

reachability.notes: Attacker can craft sidecar with empty commitments and send via gossip.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review actor-gossip-network message handling for DataColumnSidecar messages. 2. Trace the data flow from gossip reception to verify_data_column_sidecar validation. 3. Verify that empty kzg_commitments check occurs BEFORE any processing that assumes non-empty commitments. 4. Test with fuzzing: send many variants of empty/near-empty commitment arrays. 5. Monitor for panics, crashes, or resource exhaustion.
checklist.notes: Supporting check for actor-gossip-network node. Ensures gossip layer properly filters malformed sidecars before beacon node processing.

checklist.title: Verify Beacon Node Defensive Processing Against Empty Commitments

reachability.notes: Attacker can craft sidecar with empty commitments and send via gossip.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all beacon node code paths that process kzg_commitments from sidecars. 2. For each path, verify defensive checks exist even if upstream validation is bypassed. 3. Look for operations that assume len(kzg_commitments) > 0 (array indexing, division operations, loop iterations). 4. Verify error handling returns appropriate error without panicking. 5. Check that no partial state changes occur before validation completes.
checklist.notes: Supporting check for actor-beacon-node node. Defense-in-depth: even if gossip validation fails, beacon node should handle gracefully.
